title: Joining Kid Rena's band
summary: Kid Rena invited him into his band; Burns tries to remember the clarinet, trombone and banjo players.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: What was the first band you played with?

The first band I ever got in with was Kid Rene. Kid Rene. Kid Rene come to my house and told me, asked me didn't I want to play with him. And I told him I didn't know if I could play good enough. He said, oh yes, I know you can play good enough. He said, sure. I said, I heard you playing around. He said, you play swell. He said, you come on. He said, you'll never get no place if you don't get in the band and go head on and play. Now that's the words he told me. So I said, well alright then. I said, I hope I don't mess the band up. I said, I hope I don't make a mess. So he said, okay. Well, you come on. You're going to do alright. So I went there and I mean everything was alright. So I was playing since.
Who else was in that band, do you remember?
Well, he had his brothers, Joe, playing drum. And let's see, who else was playing now?
The clarinet. Let's see, who was that clarinet? Yes, I can't recall who he was. It's been so long.
No, it wasn't George. It wasn't George at that time. It wasn't George because I could remember George. But it wasn't George. It was...
Do you remember clarinet's the name of George Boyd? George Boyd.
George Boyd. Oh, George Boyd. Yeah, yeah.
Was he playing with Rene at that time or somebody else?

He did play with Rene, but I don't think he played with it the time that I played with him. I don't think it was him. You could call somebody that I could recall back to, I could maybe, could say it was, I would know it.
You'll think of it later probably. Do you remember the trombone?

The trombone, let's see, who was the trombone? The trombone, it was, let's see, oh I think it was Jim, Jim Robison I think. Oh Jim? Yeah, I think it was Jim Robison playing the trombone. Yeah, I'm most sure it was Jim playing trombone.
Well that's most of them there except guitar, you remember a guitar player.
Yeah, let's see, banjo, no, who was playing banjo, banjo? It wasn't as, let's see, should have had all that, that's all right. That's all right. That's didn't it. Of course.
